- [ASSISTANT_CREATED] Job Title: Transformation Manager
- [ASSISTANT_CREATED] Organization: Comunidad Judía de Madrid
- [ASSISTANT_CREATED] Key Responsibilities for the Transformation Manager include leading and managing complex organizational change initiatives, developing and presenting cases for change initiatives to senior leadership, monitoring progress of initiatives, developing and implementing detailed project plans, providing training and support, allocating resources, collaborating with external partners, analyzing data for improvements, and establishing communication plans.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The Transformation Manager will be responsible for leading large-scale change initiatives within the organization, working with a variety of stakeholders and aligning different departments and teams.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The goal of the Transformation Manager is to orchestrate positive impact across all transformation initiatives.
- [ASSISTANT_CREATED] Qualifications for the Transformation Manager include proven experience leading complex organizational change initiatives, excellent interpersonal and communication skills, ability to think strategically and analytically, strong project management skills and experience, experience working with cross-functional teams and collaborating with external partners, strong training and facilitation skills, and a bachelor's degree in a relevant field (advanced degree preferred).
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Comunidad Judía de Madrid is an equal opportunity employer, welcoming and encouraging applicants from all backgrounds to apply.
- [USER] User requested the qualifications to be translated into Spanish.

  - Experiencia comprobada en la conducción de iniciativas de cambio organizacional complejas
  - Excelentes habilidades interpersonales y de comunicación

  - Fuertes habilidades de gestión de proyectos y experiencia
